summary: Hardened scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh in all four plan phases: it now holds the published $REPO_ROOT/.lake/build-guard.lock flock for its whole run (joining check-module-invariants.sh's precedent rather than inventing a second lock), names an absent or half-written .lake artifact as a third ENVIRONMENT diagnostic class distinct from probe rot and from untracked, and its header states the present CI wiring in place of the stale 'not wired into CI' claim. The hard constraint holds -- git diff over specs/evidence/ is empty, no WIRED/WIRED_REPO/DEFERRED line changed, and scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh is the only non-specs path modified.
